# truenas_acme_dns_authenticator (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS ACME DNS authenticator by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (String, Sensitive) JSON document of DNS provider credentials/config, as returned by the API.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the ACME DNS authenticator.
